title: What Is a Tragedy? — A Literary Guide for English Students and Teachers
skills: define tragedy as a literary and dramatic form
identify common characteristics of tragic narratives
analyze tragic conflict, character downfall, and resolution
explain how tragedy develops theme and audience response
alignment_note: Introduces tragedy as a major literary and dramatic form and explains common features such as serious conflict, character downfall, suffering, and consequential resolution. Supports genre recognition, dramatic analysis, thematic interpretation, and comparison of tragic works across high school English courses.
